classifications._legend: BD-DESIGN-REGISTRY-01 — every screen sits on exactly one shelf. The shelf is the array it lives in plus its classification field.
classifications.render-gate: Shipped screen backed by a real Cloud Design render gate. Lives in screens[]; classification 'render-gate'.
classifications.future-design: Render gate exists but runtime is a stub / poorer than the design. Lives in screens[] with interaction 'design-render-only'; classification 'future-design'. Needs a runtime parity follow-up.
classifications.stub-foundation: Reused non-routed foundation module (e.g. Mapbox stub). Lives in foundationModules[]; classification 'stub-foundation'.
classifications.contract-only: Ships in runtime with a docs/screen-contracts.md contract but no Cloud Design render gate yet. Lives in runtimeOnly[]; classification 'contract-only'; renderStatus 'render-pending'.
classifications.runtime-only: Ships in runtime with neither a render gate nor a contract yet. Lives in runtimeOnly[]; classification 'runtime-only'; renderStatus 'render-pending'. Currently none.
_rules: runtime route AND not in this registry -> render in Cloud Design OR record in runtimeOnly[] as contract-only/runtime-only with renderStatus 'render-pending'.
Cloud Design richer than runtime -> open a parity / missing-states backlog item (docs/missing-screens.md).
present in both (render gate + runtime) -> smoke + docs drift-check only (node scripts/check.mjs).

renderGates.title: BazarDrive render gates comprehensive print
renderGates.notes: Comprehensive render-gate export from Claude Design. PDF is the visual audit artifact; standalone HTML is the archived interactive export.

renderGates.title: Driver Dashboard Profile Polish render gate
renderGates.notes: BD-PROFILE-D-03 driver dashboard render gate (merged via PR #384). Visual reference only — never copied into runtime (public/index.html and the SW precache stay free of prototype HTML).

renderGates.title: Order Detail role-split render gate
renderGates.notes: BD-ORDER-DETAIL-01 role-split render gate (issue #454) — 10 artboards: passenger P1-P4, driver D1-D4, shared S1-S2. Visual reference only — never copied into runtime (public/index.html and the SW precache stay free of prototype HTML; scripts/check.mjs skips public/prototypes). The standaloneExport is a Claude Design bundler preview (loader + JS bundle), not a parseable component export. Gate↔contract deltas (contract docs/screen-contracts.md#bd-order-detail-01 stays the behavioral source of truth for chip/CTA copy): P3 chip is ALIGNED — runtime now renders «Водитель выбран» on the passenger P3 view (driver D3 keeps «Заказ принят»). Remaining visual-only deltas (not adopted in runtime): P4 renders a single «Отменён» chip with the expiry reason as body copy (no distinct «Истёк» chip); some CTAs are icon-only or shortened (Отозвать / Написать пассажиру / Активная поездка); S1/S2 carry no status chip by design.

screens.title: Driver Dashboard Profile Polish
screens.note: Polish of the driver dashboard (BD-PROFILE-02). Five tabs (Обзор default) switch panes without remounting the top bar. Documents are readiness cards (Проверено / На проверке / Нужно обновить). Payout rows read receipt.net straight from the BD-RIDE-HISTORY-D-01 canonical receipt store (mock_api.listDriverReceipts) and show cash/noncash badges that mirror the receipt screen — no recalculation of fare / commission / tip / net in profile.js. Такси·ИП is a static demo with no tax math. Safety center and the loading/skeleton + empty-payouts states are class-driven, demo-only. Mock/UI only — no backend, no Mapbox, no real payments, no real document upload, no tax/accounting math, no CSP weakening, no inline script/style. The render-gate PDF/HTML are visual reference only and are not copied into runtime.

screens.title: Driver No-show flow
screens.note: Cross-gate 7/7 runtime coverage: active_ride.js owns waiting/expired as the existing WAITING_PASSENGER phases via renderWaiting()/renderWaitingExpired() (including ?wait=expired) plus #ar-no-show wiring, pinned by scripts/smoke-active-ride-waiting.mjs and scripts/smoke-active-ride-noshow.mjs; active_ride_driver_noshow.js owns action → confirm → result → compensation → done. The registered status=NO_SHOW route renders the terminal closed-trip stub, not the interactive sub-flow. Remaining follow-ups are separate: compensation stays demo pending product/finance sign-off; dispute and no-show loading/error remain BD-RIDE-D-DISPUTE-01 and BD-RIDE-D-NOSHOW-ERR-01; real async backend mutation failure semantics remain BD-RIDE-D-ERROR-02.

screens.title: Driver Earnings / Completion Polish
screens.note: Terminal DriverEarningsSheet over the completed map shell with seven ?state= stages (summary, cash, noncash, shift, loading, closed, empty). Mounted by renderCompleted in active_ride.js. Mock/UI only — fixed 12% commission + mock tip so net equals the balance delta (1 475 ₽); no real payments, balances, push or tax/accounting math.

screens.title: Driver Completed Ride Receipt
screens.note: Read-only closed financial document for a completed driver ride. net is computed ONCE in the completed driver earnings flow (active_ride.js → buildDriverEarningsPayload) and persisted as one canonical receipt object via mock_api.saveDriverReceipt { tripId, completedAt, fare, commission, tip, net, paymentMode, status }. Ride history, Driver payouts and this screen only READ + FORMAT the stored receipt (fare 1540, commission -185, tip 120, net 1475 ₽) — no recalculation, no drift. Mock/UI only — no backend, no real payments, no tax / accounting math.

screens.title: Chat bridge (ride + response context)
screens.note: Screen/contract entry only — references the existing BD-RENDER-GATES-2026-06-03 render gate (no new standaloneExport is added). Bridge contract: chat hydrates header + trip bar from bazardrive.active_ride.v1 when tripId+role present, from bazardrive.responses.v1 (response.driverPrice + MOCK_DRIVER) when only responseId, MOCK_DRIVER/MOCK_TRIP fallback for demo. Back deep-link returns to /active-ride?role=&tripId= when both present, /respond?postId= when response has requestId, /feed otherwise. Outgoing send writes { senderRole: viewerRole, dir: 'out' }; readers prefer senderRole via directionForMessage. BD-CHAT-01 confirmation flow (/chat → trip_confirmation.v1 → /trip-confirmation) is preserved unchanged. No section pin — chat is not a render-gate section in the 2026-06-03 PDF.

screens.title: Order Detail
screens.note: Shipped role-split runtime shell that resolves /order/<id> (Model B locked; 01D driver-offer/passenger-select writes landed; reads mock fixtures). Render gate BD-ORDER-DETAIL-01-RENDER-GATE landed (issue #454, 10 artboards). docs/screen-contracts.md#bd-order-detail-01 remains the behavioral source of truth for chip/CTA copy; the P3 passenger chip is aligned to the gate («Водитель выбран»; driver D3 keeps «Заказ принят»), remaining gate deltas (single terminal chip; icon-only/shortened CTAs) are visual-only. The render-gate PDF/HTML are visual reference only — never copied into runtime.

foundationModules.title: Driver Markers Layer
foundationModules.note: No-op / pure-helper foundation layer for plotting driver/order markers onto the MapShell placeholder. No real Mapbox SDK, no token, no network, no CDN, no inline style. Safe no-op without a real map. BD-MAP-FOUND-01 will replace the body with real Mapbox GL markers; the export contract stays stable. Not a routed screen — reused module, so it is intentionally listed here rather than in screens[].

foundationModules.title: Trip Status Layer
foundationModules.note: No-op / pure-helper foundation layer reflecting active-ride status on the MapShell placeholder. Status vocabulary mirrors RIDE_STATUS in public/src/ride_state.js. No real Mapbox SDK, no token, no network, no CDN, no inline style. Safe no-op without a real map. BD-MAP-FOUND-01 will replace the body with real Mapbox GL layers; the export contract stays stable. Not a routed screen — reused module, so it is intentionally listed here rather than in screens[].
